name: mite
description: Notes app that turns notes into designed articles. Includes Bible Studies, Return Visits and Hours Report.

scripts.android:add: npx cap add android && bash scripts/android-setup.sh
scripts.android:sync: node scripts/bundle-fonts.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:release: python3 scripts/android-signing.py && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease assembleRelease
